name: Inquisiteur de Mars
description: Supreme Commander unifiant les flottes martiennes sous un commandement unique avec une autorité absolue et indiscutable.

subject.archetype: Inquisiteur de Mars — Hégémonie martienne Legendary class obsidienne

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy combat armor with thick crimson red plating showing battle scars and scorch marks, reinforced shoulder guards with dented imperial insignia, tactical undersuit at joints, magnetic combat boots locked to metal deck with legendary cosmic materials and ancient craftsmanship that has become one with the wearer's being
loadout.arsenal: Standard-issue heavy plasma rifle with imperial engravings, combat chainsword with serrated edge, tactical grenade bandolier across chest, targeting visor HUD displaying red lock-on data The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's heal ability targeting adjacent_friendly, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Battlefield commander directing troop movements with precise gestures, tactical displays projecting from gauntlets. One hand extended toward wounded ally with massive devastating warm golden energy flowing from palm directly into ally's body creating visible bridge of healing light
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — no longer merely fighting but reshaping the battlefield itself with every movement and breath

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Crimson Red
palette_names.role: primary_accent — armor plating and blood mist in the air

palette_names.name: Gunmetal Black
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — structural elements and deepest shadows

palette_names.name: Blinding White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — muzzle flash and explosive ignition

color_and_light.lighting_setup: aurum-plated frame with living energy flowing through ornate faction-specific patterns, border radiates golden glow, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Cinematic ultra-wide angle with dramatic depth layers — foreground devastation, character as glowing focal point, background cataclysm, sky and environment permanently altered

scenography.setting: Planetary assault battlefield with artillery detonating sending massive dust columns skyward, advancing infantry silhouettes through smoke, orbital dropships descending under anti-aircraft fire, trenches littered with spent casings
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Visible energy bridge connecting healer to wounded with golden light flowing through channel and visibly mending wounds, ally's expression relaxing as pain fades and color returns, Ground between characters blooming with new growth from healing energy overflow — flowers sprouting instantly, grass recovering, path of life connecting healer to patient, Artillery shells exploding in background sending up massive geysers of red dust, tracer rounds streaking across sky, crimson smoke grenades billowing, shrapnel flying past camera, ground cracking from impact tremors
